label: Mīrāth — educational foundations
disclaimer: Educational only — not a fatwa, not legal advice, not affiliated with Al-Azhar, Madinah, or any seminary. Verify with qualified local teachers.

framing.intro: Knowledge of inheritance in Islam is taught so rights are not lost and families are not left in confusion. Study with humility; apply only with proper guidance.

quran.theme: Men and women have shares in what parents and close relatives leave.
quran.note: Opens the door: inheritance is legislated, not left to pure custom alone.

quran.theme: Detailed shares for children, parents, and spouses (among others).
quran.note: Classic teaching texts unpack these verses with the Sunnah — this course only maps the idea.
Shows that revelation addressed edge cases; learners should not invent rules.

quran.theme: Wasiyyah mentioned in a context of care for those left behind.
quran.note: Later scholarship relates wasiyyah to limits (e.g. non-heir, third) via Sunnah — educational reminder only.

sunnah.theme: Give the shares to those entitled, then what remains to the closest male relative (as reported in the Sunnah).
sunnah.note: Educational pointer — exact application needs a teacher.

sunnah.theme: No wasiyyah for an heir (as reported in the Sunnah) and the third as a known limit for bequests.
sunnah.note: Prevents using bequests to rewrite fixed shares unjustly.

sunnah.theme: Fulfill debts and rights before distribution.
sunnah.note: Order of rights protects the living and the deceased’s obligations.

units.title: Unit 1 — Adab of this knowledge
units.goal: Approach mīrāth with sincerity, not family politics.

units.title: Unit 2 — Why revelation speaks about shares
units.goal: Connect Qurʾān 4:7 and related āyāt to mercy and clarity.

units.title: Unit 3 — Who may inherit (map only)
units.goal: Name classical categories in plain language without issuing rulings.

units.title: Unit 4 — Shares as illustration
units.goal: Understand that portions exist; do not DIY a decree.

units.title: Unit 5 — Wasiyyah and the third
units.goal: Non-heir rule and 1/3 as educational limits.

units.title: Unit 7 — Common errors
units.goal: Unborn child, missing persons, non-Muslim relatives, prior spouses — as study cases.

units.title: Unit 8 — What to take to a teacher
units.goal: Leave with questions, not a self-issued judgment.
